entities.title: Replay-check MEG's scores like the other games
entities.summary: MEG's shared table trusts scores within checked limits (decisions.json, trusted-scores). Replaying each run on the server would make it cheat-proof.
acceptanceCriteria: The simulation draws random numbers only from a seeded generator and uses only + − × ÷ and Math.sqrt, as AGENTS.md requires of engines the server replays.
The run ticket carries the seed, the game records its controls, and the Worker replays the run and records the score the replay produces.

origin.description: The owner asked for a high-score list and chose trusted scores for now.
